them.zh: 按 tstack 行事的助手做的

steps.en: Copy the skill pack into your configured agent and supply GitHub and model access
steps.zh: 把技能装入已有助手，提供 GitHub 与模型接入

steps.en: Give the change goal and request a PR handoff without merging
steps.zh: 说明改动目标，要求就绪交接但不合并

steps.en: Implements and proves the change, then resolves the Sol review findings
steps.zh: 实现并验证改动，再处理 Sol 评审意见

steps.en: Files the PR and follows checks, review bots and branch freshness
steps.zh: 创建 PR，跟进检查、评审机器人与分支更新

steps.en: Leaves the ready PR open and reports evidence and remaining risks
steps.zh: 保留就绪 PR，交付证据与剩余风险

value.en: A reviewed PR handoff, rather than a PR link that leaves you to chase the remaining work
value.zh: 拿到经过评审的 PR 交接，而非仍需你追完后续工作的链接
